About Templar Transport
Templar Transport is a family run business established in 1980 to provide temperature controlled distribution across the UK. We have over 30 years experience in the transportation of chilled and frozen goods throughout the country. With a selection of modern vehicles ranging from van to articulated lorry no job is too big or small for us.
So whether a one off job or regular contract we will be happy to help.
